//: Deep links into the app. The app is a single page served from
/app/index.html; now that it has a router, URLs like /app/instructor and
/app/student/onboarding are real addresses a learner can bookmark, be
sent, or be returned to after an email confirmation link.
Without this rule the hosting layer looks for a FILE at that path, finds
nothing and returns 404 — the classic single-page-app deployment bug,
and one that only shows up in production, never in `vite dev`.
Rewrites are checked after the filesystem, so /app/index.html and every
hashed asset under /assets/ are still served directly. The landing page
at / is untouched: this matches nothing outside /app.
